accounting: physical calls count every model invocation; row evaluations count all carrier rows, even finished rows; active decisions counted separately; no speed claim
decision_gate: exact raw/syntax decisions for fixed prefixes, exact independent emitted token sequence and stop reason; both gates required regardless of near ties; report top-two margin separately

donor.limit: upstream forces singleton golden_token_ids from batched samples; does not demonstrate independently sampled RNG invariance
donor.use: idea attribution only; original MPL-2.0 implementation, no donor code/kernel dependency

endpoint_selection: all absmean/refit seeds 0/1 final step60; no selection or updates
environment: existing hash-locked Linux x86_64 CPU torch2.8.0+cpu float32, one thread, deterministic algorithms, no autocast, eval+no_grad; preserve required parameter trainability and tied output; seeds0/1 are historical initialization only, no sampling or stochastic claim
failure: retain nonconformant report with false gates and exit2; retain partial cell JSONL, logs, attempted replay output and false-match receipt on failure; fresh unique attempts and atomic no-clobber publication; never overwrite or tune on target outcomes
forced_reference: two fixed prefix stages: BOS+prompt; BOS+prompt+first token from this endpoint/item recorded syntax trajectory. This is prior model-output forcing, not gold-answer conditioning; no post-EOS prefix. Compare full 259-logit vectors and both raw and syntax decisions. Labels never enter workload projection.
gates: engineering conformance only, exposed fixtures and constant-output checkpoints; no fresh generalization, learning, quantizer-selection, performance, scaling, geometry, NCM or release claim
immutability: model identity, no parameter gradients, and Python/NumPy/Torch RNG state equality before/after each endpoint; source/input/environment request equality before/after report

independent_generation.decision: lowest numeric token ID on exact ties; raw BOS/PAD are retained, never stripped; context exhaustion stops without repair
independent_generation.finished_rows: keep group membership fixed; EOS-finished rows remain unchanged carriers, do not append EOS or emit further tokens; stop group when no active rows remain
independent_generation.syntax: ASCII 0..9 then EOS, each decision requires actual forward; no labels, arithmetic, repair or extra completion

layouts.order: reverse within each original batch8; unchanged membership
even zero-based indices then odd indices, chunked by eight

layouts.padding: maximum current live prefix length of all carrier rows in this group

numeric_gate.formula: abs(candidate-reference) <= atol + rtol*abs(reference), every one of 259 coordinates; no NaN/Inf anywhere in model output
numeric_gate.reference: all layouts vs singleton_min; additional isolated edges singleton_32->batch8_32 and batch8_32->partition4_32/reverse8_32/recompose8_32/batch8_min/payload8_32

order: train then validation, retaining original dataset order within each split; all 36+6 items; six test items excluded from numerical execution
padding: nonempty right-padded masks only; absolute live positions unchanged; fill pattern restarts at each row first masked position; gather logits at live_length-1, never physical last column
replay: exact complete deterministic report in same bound environment; batch numeric tolerance does not relax exact replay. Observed wall/RSS/status/attempt metadata are separate.
